evācāra.p: [ evaṃ + ācāra ] (ti) Google Translate This is the way to look at this, this is the way this is done, this is the way this is done.

DOP: evācāra mfn. [eva (= evaṃ) + ācāra], of such behaviour, of such conduct ; Vin IV 240, 35 (santi saṅghe aññā pi bhikkhuniyo ~ā evaṃsaddā evaṃsilokā; Sp 915, 12 : ~ā ti evamācārā, yādiso tumhākaṃ ācāro tādisācāro ti attho).
NCP: mfn. | evaacaara of such behavior, of such conduct.
